1090.description: A reverse fly using suspension handles. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight.
Open your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
Do not shrug.

1154.description: Holding the straps for balance, you rise onto your toes to train the calves.
instructions: Hold the handles and stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your body upright.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze the calves.
Lower the heels slowly below the start if comfortable.
Use the straps only for balance.

1282.description: A one-arm dumbbell press done with your upper back on a stability ball. Your core has to stay tight to keep you steady while the chest presses.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with a dumbbell in one hand, feet flat on the ground.
Slowly walk your feet forward, rolling the ball until your head, neck, and upper back are supported on the ball.
Hold the dumbbell at shoulder height with your palm facing forward.
Press the dumbbell upward until your arm is fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃，双脚平放在地上。
慢慢地向前移动你的脚，滚动球，直到你的头、脖子和上背部得到球的支撑。
将哑铃握在与肩同高的位置，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1346.description: Kneel and reach your arms overhead, then lean to one side. It stretches the lat and the side of your torso.
instructions: Kneel on the ground with your knees hip-width apart and your toes pointing back.
Extend your arms overhead and interlace your fingers.
Keeping your back straight, slowly lean to the right side, feeling a stretch in your left lat muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the stretch on the left side, leaning to the left and feeling a stretch in your right lat muscle.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽，脚趾向后。
将双臂伸过头顶，手指交叉。
保持背部挺直，慢慢向右侧倾斜，感受左侧背阔肌的拉伸。
保持伸展动作 20-30 秒，然后回到起始位置。
在左侧重复该拉伸动作，向左侧倾斜，感受右侧背阔肌的拉伸。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1410.description: With a barbell on your upper back, step to the side and sit into a lateral lunge. It works the glutes, inner thighs and quads.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Take a big step to the side with your right foot, keeping your left foot planted.
Bend your right knee and lower your body down into a lunge position, keeping your left leg straight.
Push off with your right foot and return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, stepping with your left foot.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
右脚向一侧迈出一大步，保持左脚踩地。
弯曲右膝，将身体降低到弓步位置，保持左腿伸直。
用右脚推出并返回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复，用左脚迈步。

1538.description: An overhead lift where you dip, drive and catch the bar with locked arms in a split stance.
instructions: Rack the bar on your front shoulders with elbows slightly forward.
Dip a short way with your torso upright.
Drive up explosively and press the bar overhead.
Split your feet front and back and catch with locked arms.
Bring your feet back together and lower the bar with control.

1602.description: A step-up performed side-on to the bench. It works the glutes and quads while challenging your balance.
instructions: Stand sideways next to a bench or step.
Place the inside foot fully on top.
Drive through that heel and step up until your leg is straight.
Bring your other foot up to meet it.
Step back down with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

1666.description: A one-arm hammer curl lying chest down on a bench. It trains the brachialis and biceps.
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing your body and arm fully extended.
Keep your upper arm stationary and curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 面朝下躺在平坦的长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，手掌面向身体，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，收缩二头肌。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1730.description: Alternating triceps kickbacks, seated and bent over. It isolates the triceps with a squeeze at the top.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and parallel to the ground.
Extend one arm straight back, keeping it close to your body, until your arm is fully extended.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝内。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直并与地面平行。
将一只手臂向后伸直，保持靠近身体，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

1794.description: Reaching forward with rounded shoulders opens up the space between your shoulder blades. It helps relieve a tight upper back.
instructions: Stand or sit and clasp your hands or hold a support in front of you at chest height.
Round your upper back and push your hands forward while dropping your head between your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1858.description: Decline sit-up on a lever machine that adds resistance for stronger abdominal work.
instructions: Lie back on the decline seat and hook your feet under the pads.
Cross your arms or hold the handles.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower back slowly under control.

1922.description: A lying hamstring stretch where a towel around the foot lets you pull the leg closer without strain.
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a towel around the ball of one foot.
Raise that leg toward the ceiling, holding both ends of the towel.
Keep the knee nearly straight and the other leg flat on the floor.
Gently pull the towel until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1986.description: An overhead stretch for the rotator cuff and back of the arm.
instructions: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow, palm resting on your upper back.
Use your other hand to hold the elbow.
Gently press the elbow back and down.
Keep your ribs down and chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2114.description: A seated side bend that lengthens the muscles along the side of the waist.
instructions: Sit tall on the floor or a chair with your legs crossed or feet flat.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways away from it until you feel the side of the waist stretch.
Keep both hips grounded and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2306.description: A spinning kick where you turn your body and sweep the heel in a hook around the target. Great for balance and coordination.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Turn your head and shoulders to look behind you.
Spin on the ball of your supporting foot.
Swing your kicking leg around and hook the heel across the target.
Land in a balanced stance.
Repeat, then switch sides.

2434.description: A seated rotation with a cable that trains the obliques and core.
instructions: Sit on the floor facing a low cable and hold the handle.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet if you can.
Rotate your torso from side to side.
Keep your arms steady and your core tight.
Move slowly without jerking.
Continue for the planned reps.

2562.description: A side-on step with a jump that trains power in the legs.
instructions: Stand beside a low step.
Place your near foot on the step.
Drive up with a small jump.
Land softly on the step.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

2690.description: A one-sided raise out to the side that builds the middle part of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep a soft bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

2754.description: A hip thrust with added weight for building strong glutes.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the weight across your hips.
Plant your feet flat and bend your knees.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

2946.description: A small push-up movement with one arm that moves only the shoulder blades. It builds control of the serratus anterior.
instructions: Start in a plank with one hand on the floor, the other behind your back or on your hip.
Keep your elbow locked straight.
Let your chest sink slightly between your shoulder blades.
Push the floor away to round your upper back slightly.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

3010.description: A lying EZ bar pullover with slightly bent arms. Works the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet on the floor.
Hold the EZ barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing away from you) and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight above your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the barbell in an arc motion behind your head, maintaining the slight bend in your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then return the barbell to the starting position by reversing the arc motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，头放在一端，双脚放在地板上。
旋前握住 EZ 杠铃（手掌背向您），双手与肩同宽。
将手臂伸直至胸部上方，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
以弧线动作将杠铃降低到头后，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
暂停片刻，然后通过反向弧线运动将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3202.description: A sit-up that stops at roughly half height, keeping constant tension on the abs. A gentle way to train the midsection.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3266.description: Move between a forearm plank and a high plank, one arm at a time, to train the core and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with body in a straight line.
Press up onto one hand, then the other, into a high plank.
Lower back down to your forearms one arm at a time.
Keep your hips steady and avoid rocking side to side.
Alternate which arm leads each rep.

3330.description: A side crunch combined with a bent knee lift. It trains the obliques and lower abs together.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your head and knees bent.
Lift your shoulders and knees at the same time.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.
Alternate sides through the set.

3394.description: A hip-bridge hold with alternating knee lifts that trains glutes and pelvic stability.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Raise one knee toward your chest without letting your hips drop.
Place that foot down and lift the other.
Keep squeezing your glutes the whole time.
Continue alternating for 10-20 marches.

3458.description: A wide-leg stretch for the inner thighs and groin.
instructions: Sit or stand with your legs as wide as comfortable.
Keep your toes pointing up or forward.
Lower slowly into the split.
Keep your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Come out gently.

3522.description: A one-leg glute bridge with a kettlebell pullover, working glutes and lats.
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot flat, other leg raised.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Lower the kettlebell back overhead in an arc.
Bring it back up as you hold the bridge.
Lower your hips, then switch legs.

3586.description: Hold both legs low and cross them repeatedly like scissors, working the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands under your hips.
Lift your head, shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Cross one leg over the other in a scissor motion.
Alternate sides in a controlled rhythm.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

3650.description: An explosive jump onto a box that builds leg power.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder width apart.
Swing your arms back and dip your hips.
Jump up and land softly on top of the box.
Stand fully upright.
Step down carefully and reset.

3714.description: A simple balance hold on one leg that trains stability in the ankle, hip and core.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together.
Lift one foot off the floor and bend the knee slightly.
Keep your hips level and eyes on a fixed point.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

3778.description: Lying on your back, you pedal your arms against the band like a bicycle. It hits your abs with added resistance.
instructions: Lie on your back with the band anchored behind your head, a handle in each hand.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Alternate pulling one handle toward your opposite knee in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue at a steady pace for your set.

3906.description: A kneeling push-up combined with a row that works the chest and back together.
instructions: Start in a kneeling push-up position with your hands on the floor, or on light dumbbells.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Push back up.
Pull one elbow toward your ribs.
Return that hand to the floor and alternate sides.
Keep your hips level.

3970.description: A burpee that adds a jumping jack finish and a push-up on the floor. It spikes your heart rate while working the chest, arms and legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor in a push-up and press back up.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Explode up into a jumping jack, landing softly, then flow into the next rep.

4034.description: Standing kick-back against a band that works the glutes and the back of the thigh.
instructions: Anchor the band low and loop it around one ankle.
Stand facing the anchor, holding a support and keeping your torso upright.
Press the working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

4098.description: A lateral lunge holding a kettlebell, working glutes, quads and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Take a big step to the side.
Sit back into that hip while keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return to standing.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.

4162.description: A push up where you pull a knee toward your elbow after each rep. It adds a core challenge to a standard push up.
instructions: Start in a push up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Bring one knee toward the same side elbow.
Return the foot and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips level and your core braced.

4226.description: A shrug performed lying down with a cable pulling from your feet. It trains the upper traps with steady tension.
instructions: Lie on your back with a low pulley near your feet.
Hold the handle with straight arms down by your sides.
Shrug your shoulders toward your ears.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your arms straight throughout.

4290.description: A split-stance lunge done in place with dumbbells in hand. It builds strength in the front thigh and glutes without any stepping.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand in a long split stance, rear heel lifted.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Bend both knees and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand back up without moving your feet.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

4354.description: A crunch that alternates elbow-to-knee across the body, hitting the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to center and switch sides.
Move slowly and avoid pulling on your neck.

4482.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the area just under the lower ribs. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your area just under the lower ribs while lying face down.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Use gentle pressure and breathe slowly so your stomach stays relaxed.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4546.description: A biceps curl where the bar is dragged up along the body, keeping the load on the biceps and reducing shoulder swing.
instructions: Stand close to the smith bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Let the bar hang at arm length against your thighs.
Pull your elbows back and drag the bar up along your torso.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar along the same line with control.
Keep your torso still and avoid leaning back.

4674.description: A deep lunge stretch with the back foot raised on a bench, targeting the quads and hip flexors.
instructions: Place the top of your back foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot forward into a lunge.
Tuck your pelvis and push your hips forward.
Keep your chest tall and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

4738.description: A goblet squat followed by a biceps curl in the bottom position. It combines leg and arm work in one rep.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell by one end at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up and elbows inside your knees.
At the bottom, lower the dumbbell and curl it back up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Repeat the full sequence for each rep.

4802.description: Walking on the balls of your feet with heels lifted. It works the calves and the small stabilisers of the feet and ankles.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Keep your heels lifted as high as you comfortably can.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps.
Keep your core tight and your gaze forward.
Walk for 20-30 steps, rest, and repeat.

4866.description: A seated floor overhead press with legs straight. It builds shoulders and core.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight and the bar at your shoulders.
Brace your core.
Press the bar overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower to the shoulders.

4930.description: A low lunge held to stretch the front of the hip and thigh. It opens up the hips.
instructions: Step one foot forward into a lunge, back knee down on a mat.
Keep your torso upright.
Push your hips gently forward.
Feel the stretch in the front of the back hip and thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

4994.description: Lying on your back, you cross straight legs over each other. It works the lower abs and inner thighs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your sides.
Lift both legs a little off the floor with your lower back pressed down.
Open them wide, then cross one leg over the other.
Open again and cross with the other leg on top.
Keep your core tight throughout.

5058.description: Kneeling side neck stretch. It releases tension in the sides and back of the neck.
instructions: Kneel tall with your back straight.
Tilt your head to one side, ear toward shoulder.
Place a hand lightly on your head for a gentle pull.
Keep the opposite shoulder low.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

5122.description: Lift a barbell from the floor to your shoulders, then drive it overhead. A technical full-body lift for power and speed.
instructions: Set up over the bar with a flat back and hands outside your knees.
Pull the bar off the floor and catch it at your shoulders in a squat.
Stand up with the bar racked.
Dip slightly and drive the bar overhead, splitting your feet.
Recover your feet, stand tall and lower the bar under control.

5250.description: A lying alternating crunch that pedals the legs while the elbow meets the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Extend one leg while turning your opposite elbow toward the other knee.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

5314.description: A step-up with a forward lean and a high box that shifts the work onto the glutes.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and face a bench or box.
Place one foot fully on the box and lean your torso slightly forward.
Push through the heel of that foot to stand up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

5378.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the front shoulder and chest. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie face down with the roller under your front shoulder.
Place the roller under the front shoulder and chest and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll small amounts toward the chest and back.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5634.description: Narrow stance squat holding dumbbells to build the quads.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides with feet close together.
Brace your core.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up to stand.
Keep your heels down.

5698.description: Walk forward while rising high onto your toes with each step, holding dumbbells. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Stand tall and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Step forward and stay up on your toes.
Alternate steps, keeping your heels lifted.
Walk for the set distance, then lower your heels.

5890.description: A seated pose with one shin stacked on the other. Opens the outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Sit with your legs crossed and stack one shin on top of the other.
Flex your feet to protect your knees.
Sit tall, then hinge forward over your shins.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Swap which leg is on top and repeat.

6146.description: A dumbbell row where you lean on a wall for support. It trains the back while sparing the lower back.
instructions: Stand a step from a wall and hinge forward.
Support your forehead or free hand on the wall.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging.
Row the weights toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.

6210.description: A side plank on the left with a crunch that brings elbow and knee together. It challenges the obliques.
instructions: Set up in a left side plank on your forearm, top hand behind your head.
Lift your top leg slightly.
Bring your top elbow and knee together in front of you.
Extend back out to the straight position.
Repeat for reps, then do the other side.

6466.description: A side plank with a bent top leg that you lift, challenging your obliques and outer hips.
instructions: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line.
Bend your top knee and lift it upward.
Lower it without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

6786.description: A gentle hip check where the ankle rests on the opposite knee and the knee drops out. It shows how mobile the hip is.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Place one foot on the opposite knee.
Let the bent knee drop out to the side.
Relax and notice how far it goes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing it.
Switch legs.

6914.description: A variation of the seated shoulder blade squeeze with the arms held out. It strengthens the upper back and posture muscles.
instructions: Sit tall with elbows bent and hands by your ribs.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Draw your elbows back and pinch your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 2-3 seconds.
Return slowly and repeat.

7234.description: Light dumbbell rotation that strengthens the small muscles behind the shoulder and between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Keep your upper arm still and your shoulder blade pulled back and down.
Rotate your forearm outward as far as you comfortably can.
Pause briefly, then slowly return to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

7554.description: Easier bodyweight row under parallel bars with knees bent.
instructions: Lie under parallel bars and grab them.
Bend your knees with feet on the floor.
Keep your body straight from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest to the bars.
Lower slowly.

7746.description: Kneel with your feet anchored and lower your body forward slowly. It is a demanding hamstring strengthener.
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your ankles held down firmly.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands at the bottom.
Push back up and repeat.

8002.description: A band chop in a wide stance where you resist twisting. It strengthens the abs and obliques.
instructions: Anchor the band at one side and stand sideways with your feet wide.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Brace your core.
Press or chop diagonally while keeping your torso square.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.

8130.description: A flowing version of child's pose that rocks the body to stretch the back, hips and shoulders.
instructions: Start on all fours with your knees slightly wider than your hips.
Sit your hips back toward your heels and reach your arms forward.
Let your chest sink toward the floor.
Rock forward and back slowly, then walk your hands to each side.
Breathe deeply and relax your neck.
Move gently for 30 to 60 seconds.

8194.description: From lying on your back, you draw your knees toward your chest. It works the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Draw your knees up toward your chest.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without arching.

9410.description: A standing calf raise with a bent knee and the balls of your feet on a raised edge, which shifts work toward the soleus. The deficit gives a deeper stretch at the bottom.
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand with the balls of your feet on a low platform.
Soften your knees into a slight bend and keep that angle throughout.
Lower your heels below the platform until you feel a stretch in your calves.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly with control.

9602.description: A step-down from a box that strengthens the quads and teaches knee control.
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Touch the floor lightly.
Push up through the standing leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

9986.description: A foot exercise where you scrunch a towel on the floor with your toes. It strengthens the muscles of the foot and arch.
instructions: Stand with one foot flat on a towel laid on a smooth floor.
Keep your heel down.
Curl your toes to pull the towel toward you.
Release and repeat until the towel is bunched under your foot.
Hold on to a support if you need balance.
Do your reps, then switch feet.

10050.description: A combo move where you lift into a superman on the floor, then press into a push-up.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor and hold briefly.
Lower and place your hands under your shoulders.
Press up into a push-up.
Lower your chest back to the floor.
Repeat, keeping your body straight.

10114.description: A plate raise that sweeps the weight out and up in a U shape, working the shoulders and upper traps.
instructions: Stand tall holding a weight plate with both hands at thigh height.
Raise the plate out and up in a wide arc until it is about overhead.
Pause briefly, keeping your ribs down and core tight.
Lower the plate back along the same path with control.
Use a light plate and avoid leaning back.

10562.description: A reverse lunge holding a kettlebell on the same side as the working leg, ending with a high knee. It trains balance and leg drive.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Step back with the leg on the same side as the bell.
Lower into a lunge.
Drive up and lift that knee high as you stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

10754.description: Hopping on one leg using mostly the ankles. It builds calf power and springy ankles.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms relaxed.
Push through the ball of your foot and jump up using mainly your ankles.
Keep the knee nearly straight in the air.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Rebound right away into the next hop.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

10818.description: A balance hop on one leg in four directions. It trains power, balance and ankle stability.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hop forward and land softly.
Hop back to the start, then out to the side and back.
Hop in the fourth direction.
Stick every landing.
Switch legs.

10882.description: An explosive push-up from the knees. It builds pressing power.
instructions: Kneel in a push-up position with hands under shoulders.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands leave the floor.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep.

11010.description: A lying move where you lift the hips so the lower back leaves the floor. It targets the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs raised toward the ceiling.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips so your lower back comes off the floor.
Lower slowly with control.
Avoid swinging.

11266.description: A standing cable leg raise to the side. It strengthens the outer hip.
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley on the near side and hold something for balance.
Stand tall with your core tight.
Lift your outside leg out to the side.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

11650.description: A seated one-leg calf raise that mainly hits the soleus using only your body weight.
instructions: Sit on a chair with one foot flat on the floor, knee bent to 90 degrees.
Lift the other foot off the floor or tuck it behind.
Press through the ball of the working foot and raise your heel.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

11714.description: A pull-up done hanging from ropes, which adds a big grip challenge to the vertical pull.
instructions: Hang from two ropes with arms straight and legs together.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull yourself up until your hands reach chest or chin level.
Keep your elbows pointing down and close.
Lower under control to a full hang.

0002.description: A standing side bend that works the obliques by leaning the torso sideways and coming back up.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended straight down by your sides.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, slowly bend your torso to one side, lowering your hand towards your knee.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂在身体两侧笔直向下伸展。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与，慢慢将躯干向一侧弯曲，将手向膝盖方向放低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0066.description: A deadlift variation where the bar is lowered along one side of the body. Works the glutes and hips.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Bend at the hips and lower the barbell towards the outside of your leg, keeping your arm straight and your chest up.
Lower the barbell as far as you can while maintaining good form.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住杠铃，正握。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
臀部弯曲，将杠铃向腿外侧放低，保持手臂伸直，挺胸。
尽可能降低杠铃，同时保持良好的姿势。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0130.description: A hip extension from a bench, lifting the hips to work the glutes.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back against the bench and your feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands on the bench for support.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then lift your hips off the bench until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部靠在长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在长凳上以获得支撑。
收紧臀肌和腿筋，然后将臀部抬离长凳，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0194.description: Overhead triceps extension with a rope on a high pulley. Extending the arms against the cable loads the triceps through a long range.
instructions: Attach a rope to a cable machine at a high position.
Stand facing away from the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope with both hands, palms facing each other, and bring your hands above your head.
Keep your upper arms close to your head and your elbows pointing forward.
Slowly lower the rope behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳索连接到高处的缆绳机上。
背对机器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
双手抓住绳子，掌心相对，将双手举过头顶。
保持上臂靠近头部，肘部向前。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将绳子降低到头后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0258.description: A push-up that moves around like a clock, with an arm reaching out to the side on each rep. It works the chest, shoulders and core.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
As you lower, rotate your body to the left, extending your left arm straight out to the side.
Push back up to the starting position, while rotating your body to the center.
Repeat the push-up, this time rotating your body to the right and extending your right arm out to the side.
Continue alternating sides with each repetition.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
当你下降时，将你的身体向左旋转，将你的左臂伸直到侧面。
向上推回到起始位置，同时将身体旋转到中心。
重复俯卧撑，这次将身体向右旋转，并将右臂向侧面伸出。
每次重复时继续交替进行。

0322.description: An incline curl that emphasises the inner biceps. The dumbbells curl up from a deep stretch behind the body.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Rest your upper arms on the bench, allowing your elbows to hang down and your palms to face forward.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在上斜凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将上臂放在长凳上，让肘部下垂，手掌朝前。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0386.description: A reverse fly with a rotation of the arms at the top. It works the rear shoulders, rotator cuff and upper back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Raise your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, until they are parallel to the floor.
Rotate your arms so that your palms are facing downwards.
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内。
稍微弯曲膝盖，臀部向前转动，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将手臂向两侧举起，肘部保持轻微弯曲，直到与地板平行。
旋转手臂，使手掌朝下。
慢慢地将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0450.description: A hybrid between a close-grip press and a skull crusher using an EZ bar. It builds the triceps and the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the ez barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower the barbell to your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in close to your body.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃降低到胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0514.description: A bodyweight squat finished with an explosive jump. It builds leg power and conditioning.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Jump explosively off the ground, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
While in mid-air, quickly bring your arms forward for balance.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性地跳离地面，伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝。
在半空中时，快速将手臂向前伸以保持平衡。
脚掌轻轻落地，然后立即进入下一个重复动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

0578.description: A machine deadlift that lets you hinge and stand up against a set load. Works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and foot platform to your desired position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the foot platform.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the seat for stability.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, and push through your heels to lift the weight up.
Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
Extend your hips fully at the top of the movement, squeezing your glutes.
Lower the weight back down in a controlled manner, keeping tension on your glutes and hamstrings.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将座椅高度和脚踏板调整到您想要的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在脚踏板上。
抓住把手或座椅侧面以保持稳定性。
收紧臀肌和腿筋，并通过脚后跟推动举重。
保持背部挺直，避免圆肩。
在动作的最高点完全伸展臀部，挤压臀部。
以受控的方式降低重量，保持臀肌和腿筋的张力。
重复所需的重复次数。

0642.description: A push-up where you kick one leg out to the side at the top. Adds core and hip work to the chest and arm effort.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
As you push back up, kick one leg out to the side, extending it fully and engaging your glutes.
Return your leg to the starting position and repeat the push-up, alternating legs with each repetition.
Continue alternating leg kicks and push-ups for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
弯曲肘部，将身体降低到地面，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
当你向后推时，将一条腿踢向一侧，完全伸展并启动臀部。
将腿恢复到起始位置并重复俯卧撑，每次重复时交替腿。
继续交替踢腿和俯卧撑，达到所需的重复次数。

0706.description: A side plank held on one forearm. It strengthens the sides of your trunk.
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked.
Place your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips until you form a straight line.
Brace your abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

0770.description: A back squat with the bar guided by the smith machine. It builds the thighs and glutes with extra stability.
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at an appropriate height for your squat.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper traps and shoulders.
Grip the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and unrack the barbell, stepping back to clear the rack.
Keeping your chest up and back straight, initiate the squat by bending at the hips and knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机和杠铃设置在适合深蹲的高度。
站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将自己置于杠铃下方，将其放在斜方肌上部和肩膀上。
宽握距握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
启动你的核心并打开杠铃，后退以清理架子。
保持胸部挺直，背部挺直，通过弯曲臀部和膝盖开始深蹲。
降低身体，直到大腿与地面平行或稍低于地面。
在底部停顿片刻，然后用脚后跟恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0834.description: A front raise with weights, lifting straight arms to shoulder height. It builds the front delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your arms straight, exhale and lift the dumbbells in front of you until they are at shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向大腿。
保持双臂伸直，呼气并将哑铃举至身前，直至与肩齐平。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0962.description: From a wide stance, reach sideways over the front leg with arms in a line. It stretches the hamstrings, hips and sides.
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart and turn one foot out 90 degrees.
Raise your arms to shoulder height.
Reach toward the front foot, then lower that hand to your shin or the floor.
Extend the other arm up and look toward it.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch sides.
